hook.name: LiquidHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies separate static LP fee tiers for the "liquid" token and the paired token, with a 20% protocol fee extracted from each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Supports an optional MEV module that can temporarily raise fees during pool launch and optional pool extension callbacks for custom post-swap logic.
